name: hessian
title: Numerical Hessian. Richardson reads the second derivatives from genD.

origin.description: Numerical Hessian. Richardson reads the second derivatives from genD.
origin.details: Numerical Hessian. Richardson reads the second derivatives from genD.
origin.value: The same value R returns for this call.
origin.example:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(numDeriv))
func <- function(x) x[1]^2 + 3 * x[1] * x[2] + x[2]^2
hessian(func, c(1, 1))
